notes.title: Update #8
notes.content:
This is another update for the demo version. As always, the update is based not only on my personal tests but also on your feedback and recommendations, dear players. Thank you all for your feedback. Thanks to you, the game is getting even better!

[h3]List of changes:[/h3]

1. Improved the game’s main menu. Added new buildings.
2. Added a new difficulty level “Mortal”. On this difficulty, enemies are as strong as on the “Hell” difficulty. The hero has only one life and no access to the shared storage!
3. Now the skill and potion slots in the bottom panel are saved when re-entering the game.
4. Improved the effects of traces from melee weapon hits and arrows flying.
5. Added the ability to reassign the keys for “interaction”, “main skill slot” and “player camera rotation”.
6. Fixed bots gravity.
7. Improved arrow movement.
8. Fixed a bug where the hero, after a continuous attack, would turn towards the zero coordinates if the enemy was already dead.
9. Fixed a bug where the hero’s health would regenerate after death.
10. Increased the maximum hero level to 120.
11. Fixed a bug where it was possible to assign multiple actions to one key in the settings, as well as other minor bugs in the control settings.
12. Visually improved the enemy health bar.
13. Fixed a bug where after interrupting the hero’s attack or his death, he retained the glow effect as if he was using a skill.
14. Fixed a bug with the active red skill, where the stats from the skill would sometimes not be subtracted after its activation.
15. Improved the simulation of enemy physics during overkill.
16. Other fixes and improvements.

[previewyoutube=7THLjxUZwes;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update #7
notes.content:
This is another update of the demo version.

As always, the update was made not only based on personal tests, but also on feedback and recommendations from players.
Thanks to all players for your feedback. Thanks to you, the game is getting even better!

1. Added 12 new recipes for crafting artifacts and weapons that were not available before.
2. Fixed a bug where when closing the inventory using a key, other windows, such as the "split components" window and the "notes" window, remained open.
3. Fixed a bug where the name of an item on the ground was not hidden, but followed the hero.
4. Fixed a bug where items in the storage did not change their availability status (remained red) if the requirements were met.
5. Fixed a bug where when hovering the cursor over the notes window, interaction objects such as the storage and others were highlighted.
6. Fixed a bug where items would incorrectly display their background when dragged and closed the inventory the next time the inventory was opened. For this reason, dragging an item now stops working if the inventory is closed.
7. Fixed bugs related to keys and hanging cages.
8. Fixed a bug where the amount of damage was displayed incorrectly for 2 identical weapons when leveling up.
9. Added the ability to open the inventory when other windows are open. Also, opening windows is now blocked when the settings menu is open.
10. Fixed a bug where the grid for slots in the storage sometimes disappeared.
11. Fixed incorrect display of the description of a crafting item for recipes when it is in the storage.
12. Adjusted the display and description of talismans and recipes.
13. Fixed a bug with duplicating potions when dragging them into the storage.
14. Fixed the order of displaying item descriptions when hovering over them: recipe/ready item and equipped item/item in inventory.
15. Fixed a bug where you could move notes and keys to the general storage with the right mouse button.
16. Added the ability to interrupt dragging an item with the right mouse button.
17. Improved enemy behavior.
18. Shortened the text of attack parameters in the character statistics window. Also, when a 2-handed weapon is equipped, the column for the left hand becomes gray (indicating that the weapon for the left hand is not used).
19. Replaced the "Important Place" marker on the map with "Respawn Point".
20. Fixed and improved the system for calculating converted damage.
21. Fixed a bug where character stats were not updated when components were added to equipment items.
22. Now loot dropped and not picked up from enemies disappears from the game when the hero dies.
23. Fixed other minor errors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849106/d5222e3e245246e1cae39aa2dfdcd4b818acd419.png[/img]

Be sure to update the game!

I'll continue to release updates and add content so you can enjoy the game.

With respect to the players, Mystic Blade

notes.title: Big update #2
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm excited to announce a big update for the Rekesh Gaal demo! This update brings a ton of new features and improvements, and I can't wait for you to try it out!

[b][h3]Key Changes[/h3][/b]

[b]Saving and Respawning:[/b] Save your progress at any time! The game now saves your inventory, storage, skills, and more. You can create up to 10 characters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849106/f1bffd32762671230ba07e6782f918c1dba05bf4.png[/img]

Items placed in the Transfer Area are now saved and available to all your characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849106/8aca931af9bc676d15fb7f1a25d31c4099a25d01.png[/img]

[b]Respawn System:[/b] Introducing the “Attraction Altar”, a new object that restores your health and acts as a respawn point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849106/85a2c202b9ba9818fc0e090388338d6210fa6ddf.png[/img]

[b]Difficulty Diversity:[/b] Enemies on higher difficulties react faster and have a higher chance of dropping Legendary and Epic items. On Hell difficulty, enemies can be equipped with items that can be obtained after defeating them.

[b]Battle Mechanics Improvements:[/b] The mini-boss now has a new special attack and an improved old special attack. I improved the knockback system and enemy death effects. The combat system for all characters has also been improved overall.

[b][h3]Additional Changes[/h3][/b]

[b]UI:[/b] I have added a new character creation window to the game with options to select difficulty and starting weapon. Several other UI elements in the game have also been improved.

[b]Balance:[/b] Item and skill stats have been adjusted for better balance and variety. The chance of getting legendary, epic, and rare items has been significantly reduced, which is more in line with what will be in the release version of the game.

[b]New Locations:[/b] The foggy area on the lower level has been expanded.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Numerous bugs reported by players over the past few months have been fixed, including issues with enemy gravity, the monologue system, and more.


I hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements! 


With respect, Mystic Blade

notes.title: Update #6
notes.content:
This is another update to the demo version.
As always, the update was made not only based on personal tests, but also based on feedback and recommendations from players.
Thanks to all players for your feedback. Thanks to you, the game becomes even better!

Improvements and fixes:

1. The hitboxes of enemies, barrels and vases have been increased.
2. Fixed a bug when loot from hanging metal cages or barrels ended up in inaccessible places. Also now loot appears instantly when destroying enemies, barrels, etc.
3. Fixed a bug due to which items would sometimes appear as available for use if the requirements were not met, and vice versa.
4. Fixed a bug where the icon on the second occupied slot of an equipped two-handed weapon disappeared.
5. Fixed a bug due to which character attributes were calculated incorrectly.
6. Added display of requirements for unready skills in the skills window, and slightly reduced stat requirements for all skills.
7. Increased attack speed with large shields, but also reduced movement speed when used in the active slot.
8. For all characters, the knockback effect when receiving over-damage has been adjusted.
9. Improved item sorting system. Now the same parts of components and talismans in a bag or storage are folded when sorted or manually, rather than folded when picked up, as was the case before.
10. Improved skills - Circles. The radius for them has been increased and a bug where circles overlapped walls has been fixed.
11. The duration of the freeze and shock effect has been reduced for all characters.
12. Impact sounds and other sounds have been corrected.
13. The behavior of enemies has been adjusted. They no longer try to bypass the bodies of other fallen enemies. Enemy spawns have also been adjusted.
14. Improved appearance of the secret room.
15. Fixed a bug where the cursor would not respond for one second when the character was running after an object.
16. Fixed a bug with incorrect offset of slots and buttons in the altar at different screen resolutions.
17. Fixed a bug when parts of barrels and vases flew through walls.
18. Now you can add components to already equipped armor and weapons.

The video below shows some of the improvements and how the mechanics of stacking components and upgrading equipment with components now work.

[previewyoutube=Ajn-5cc_3JY;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to update the game!


I'll continue to release updates and add content so you can enjoy the game.


With respect to the players, Mystic Blade

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
This is a relatively minor update for the demo game.

The main reason for releasing this update is to add difficulty levels to the game. And of course, correction of minor bugs and errors in the text.

There are now three game modes available in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849106/9c57e136181c6ad98c4ed64f1d751dd0e1e2df11.png[/img]

- Normal - suitable for those who are playing the game for the first time or for beginners
- Hard - for experienced ARPG game players. To survive, you need to use skills, strengthen weapons and act wisely
- Hell - very high level of difficulty. This is for true hardcore fans! To survive, you will need to competently build your character, use skills, conduct tactical battles, and of course hope for a successful drop of items!

Be sure to update the game!

I'll continue to release updates and add content so you can enjoy the game.


With respect to the players, Mystic Blade

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
This is an unplanned update that I decided to release due to many bugs in the game that players and I have identified.


New in the game:

- added option to select starting weapon at the beginning of the game
- added pop-up hints for the amount of damage when hitting a dummy
- now you can destroy several barrels or vases at once with one blow

List of fixes and improvements:

- Fixed many bugs in the character window. Namely, the incorrect display of various types of damage and effects and errors associated with updating the character statistics panel has been corrected
- bugs in skills have been fixed. Namely, incorrect subtraction and addition of indicators when, during the action of a skill, its level increases in the skill window or when equipping items that increase the level of this skill
- fixed a bug in obtaining extra experience from notes. Now, to get the experience, you need to burn the note
- characteristics requirements for items are no longer visible if the requirements have already been met
- fixed a bug when enemies turned around when dying
- reduced the chance of rare items dropping at the beginning of the game
- fixed a bug when the form window was not updated if characteristics were added from the character window
- increased the performance of the bow, which can be selected at the start of the game
- reducing the number of enemies at the start and increasing at the end of the level for better balance in the game
- the frequency of appearance of combat prompts has been adjusted and increased

Be sure to update the game!

I'll continue to release updates and add content so you can enjoy the game.


With respect to the players, Mystic Blade

4. Fixed a bug when enemies with a bow did not shoot arrows
5. Other minor adjustments made
